scope.reviewed: Only the two exact new C2 policy loss/test files. Existing C2 executor and original policy configure/loss functions were read as interface and formula background.

background_context.purpose: Keyword-only preview interfaces, C2 missing-stream conditioning, registered adapter parameters and executor/policy ownership. Context only, not an additional admitted source.
Original configure_policy_refresh and policy_refresh_loss definitions only as semantic background. Context only; this existing file is not changed or newly admitted.

C2_preview_interface.evidence: preview_state is called once per loss call with gradients enabled. That same preview object is explicitly supplied to both C2 primary calls and all eight C2 correct calls through the required keyword-only preview parameter. Candidate generation and later gain prediction use the same preview. This addresses the demonstrated missing keyword argument in the old policy loss without changing the executor interface.

current_labels_and_gradient_boundary.evidence: Both primary outcomes, candidate sets and eight query outcomes are recomputed inside torch.no_grad using the current preview. Quality targets are negative current primary localization loss; action gain targets are current primary loss minus current corrected loss. Targets and executor outcome tensors do not retain gradients. Quality and gain predictions remain differentiable through the current policy preview, with detached executor outcomes as label-side inputs. Toy tests show changed preview produces new primary/candidate/gain targets.

original_label_and_loss_definitions.evidence: An independent AST comparison matched both configure and loss functions after normalizing only explicit primary/correct preview keywords, docstrings, dict-construction notation and bound list-comprehension variable names. Localization-loss quality/gain labels, smooth-L1 reductions, two-modality averaging, no-query gain slicing and quality+gain+0.1*spatial weighting are preserved.

spatial_labels_and_off_crop.evidence: Spatial CE uses finite target centres in [0,1), maps them to the same8x8 cells and averages two preview maps. Off-crop centres omit spatial CE while retaining localization-derived quality/gain training. The toy off-crop test obtains a finite loss and policy gradient.

executor_parameter_and_buffer_boundary.evidence: Configuration freezes all registered model parameters first, then enables only preview/quality/gain parameters. Registered C2 missing-stream and backbone adapter parameters remain frozen. The returned optimizer groups contain preview at1e-5 and quality/gain at1e-4. model.eval() preserves evaluation behavior for BN and dropout while leaving policy gradients enabled. The toy test verifies disjoint complete policy groups, nonzero gradients and real CPU AdamW changes in all three policy modules, with executor/missing/adapter parameters and BN state_dict buffers unchanged.
executor_parameter_and_buffer_boundary.caller_requirement: A future fit entry must preserve this configuration and eval behavior throughout its updates and verify actual executor parameters/buffers independently. This primitive does not admit or configure a production entry.
executor_parameter_and_buffer_boundary.state_scope: Frozen state refers to parameter and buffer tensors. Real C2 encode still sets transient adapter route attributes as designed; no all-Python-attribute immutability or tracker-state acceptance is claimed.

input_and_window_boundary.evidence: The explicit window must be present and is passed unchanged to every primary/query call. Toy tests verify the same object reaches all ten routes, no input tensor changes, and None is rejected. The primitive itself makes no tracker update.

separate_primitive_and_future_admission.evidence: The new module defines only configure and loss functions. It introduces no entry point, collection workflow, launch command, GPU plan or concrete admitted binding. Existing loader sources/review and active training files were not modified.
